review_rationale: Independent fresh-context source review, two rounds: doc/source_audits/batch_138.json. The reviewer re-derived the receipt (21 sections, 64 units, 0 hash mismatches) and INDEPENDENTLY RE-PARTITIONED the four crowded pages - p303, p304, p306 and p307 - unit by unit, confirming among other things that 13.8.8 genuinely owns only p1 despite covering six rounding-mode descriptors. A mis-attributed paragraph would have been invisible in the totals, since 64 would still be 64. The zero-numbered-R/C claim was verified: R1323 appears on p302 but belongs to the sibling 13.7.2.4 packet. FOUR blocking findings, all closed. C138SR-001: a negative was filed against 13.7.5.2.2, which only CROSS-REFERS to the rule - the actual prohibition is 13.7.5.1 p1 'On input, w shall not be zero' - and 'Note that w cannot be zero' is a reminder, not a prohibition; the facet is now an explicit dependency. C138SR-002: four units filed LATITUDE AS REQUIREMENTS - the fifth occurrence of the mixed obligation/latitude class, and notably the MIRROR of the sibling packet, which filed obligations as permission; all four were split into requirement and permission subunits. C138SR-003: an output-control facet sat under 13.9 p1, which owns only the input prohibition; output moved to p2. C138SR-004: a negative named a descriptor but NO DATUM, so nothing showed the p6 branch was reached; it now uses datum zero with (G4.1E3), where s=1 reaches the F branch, n=e+2=5 and w-n=-1, with repair (G7.1E3) expecting exactly '0.     ' - the reviewer derived all of that independently. Source accounting only: authored_facets unchanged at 1977.
